key_facts.shares: 485,055,672 (pre-committed); full outstanding shares to be acquired

name_jp: 大黒屋ホールディングス
summary_en: Godo Kaisha Kodo, a special purpose company established by Daikokuya Holdings' representative director Shoji Shimano, is launching a tender offer to acquire all shares of Daikokuya Holdings Co., Ltd. (Code: 6993) listed on TSE Standard Market. The offeror has entered into an agreement to acquire 485,055,672 shares (64.38% of outstanding shares) held by S Bank, a fund managed by Keystone Partners. Shimano is expected to continue as representative director post-completion.
